engine.block.casting.name: Cylinder block
engine.block.casting.material: Cast iron, integral cylinders and waterways (Haynes p25)
engine.block.casting.notes: 18G block with three main bearings. Bore and stroke are published; the outer form is derived. The crank centre height comes from the published stroke, rod length and piston compression height. Water jacket and oilways are not modelled, so the model is solid where the real block is hollow. Firing order 1-3-4-2, No 1 cylinder next to the radiator (Haynes p20). External form (derived from Haynes Fig 1.8, Haynes photos 58.4, 61.1(a) and 55.4, and owners' photos of bare 18G blocks). Left side: a proud tappet chest panel with two openings and gasket faces, the camshaft tunnel showing as a shelf below it, the oil pump drive pillar under the skew gear, the blanked fuel pump flange (stud 12), the cast "1800" panel, the relief valve boss at the left rear (Haynes Sec 17) with plug 7 beside it, and the drain tap boss at the front. Right side: a straight water-jacket wall with the engine number plate pad below the deck (Haynes p7: plate on the right-hand side), two side core plugs, a ledge carrying the main oil gallery and the leaning distributor housing boss, then the crankcase wall with the oil filter pad and dipstick boss. Both sides: main web ribs and a pocketed sump flange.

specs.ref: Half stroke 44.45 (H p20) + rod centres 165.1 (H p21) + compression height 42.06 (FIA 3016)

engine.head.casting.name: Cylinder head
engine.head.casting.material: Cast iron (Haynes p25), painted with the engine
engine.head.casting.notes: Layout from Haynes Fig 1.5 (plan of the head with nut order), scaled so the eight valves fit the published 14.031 in rocker shaft. Bathtub chambers, siamesed inlet ports (two inlet, three exhaust: FIA homologation 3016), pushrods on the manifold side, plugs on the right-hand side. Water jacket, oilways and core detail are not modelled, so the model is solid where the real casting is hollow (about 4.5 litres of iron, heavier than the real head). External form (derived): raised rocker cover rail, recessed valley with spring seats and rocker pedestal pads standing proud, a proud port band on the manifold side, recessed panels between the plug bosses, and a heater outlet boss on the rear end.

specs.ref: Plug position along the floor; not published

engine.lube.sump-gasket.name: Sump gasket
engine.lube.sump-gasket.notes: Haynes Sec 55 para 4 - grease the crankcase flange and position the new gasket.

engine.lube.pump-body.name: Oil pump body
engine.lube.pump-body.notes: Hobourn-Eaton rotor pump (Haynes p22) held to the crankcase by three nuts (Sec 21 para 2), driven by a shaft from the camshaft skew gear.

engine.lube.pump-inner-rotor.name: Oil pump inner rotor
engine.lube.pump-inner-rotor.notes: Four lobes; lobe clearance to be no more than 0.006 in (Haynes Sec 34 para 4).

engine.lube.pump-outer-rotor.name: Oil pump outer rotor
engine.lube.pump-outer-rotor.notes: Five lobes, chamfered end toward the driving end of the pocket (Sec 34 para 7).

engine.lube.pump-spindle.name: Oil pump drive shaft
engine.lube.pump-spindle.notes: Driven by the camshaft skew gear; lifted out with the pump (Sec 21 para 2).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: From the pump rotors up to the camshaft skew gear

specs.label: Across flats
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/16 in

specs.label: Thickness
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/16 in

engine.lube.strainer.name: Oil strainer and pick-up pipe
engine.lube.strainer.notes: Gauze bowl on the sump floor with a centre nut and bolt and a flanged pipe to the pump (Haynes Sec 20 para 7, photo 55.2).

specs.label: Pump inlet drop
specs.ref: Inlet boss below the pump flange

engine.lube.filter-head.name: Oil filter head
engine.lube.filter-head.notes: Early type with the bowl hanging below the head and the centre bolt entering from underneath (Fig 1.1).

specs.label: Seat diameter
specs.ref: Takes the bowl lip; not published

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Proportion from Fig 1.1 and owners' photos

engine.lube.filter-element.name: Oil filter element
engine.lube.filter-element.notes: Renewable felt element, full flow (Haynes p22).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the bowl into the head

specs.label: Torque
specs.note: Oil filter centre bolt (early models only)

engine.lube.filter-head-seal.name: Bowl sealing ring
engine.lube.filter-head-seal.notes: Haynes Sec 2 para 8 - remove the old sealing ring from the groove in the filter head; fit a new one.

engine.lube.oil-pipe.name: External oil pipe
engine.lube.oil-pipe.notes: From the pump delivery at the right rear of the crankcase forward to the filter head, banjo unions at each end (Fig 1.16 item 6; owners' photos).

engine.lube.relief-nut.name: Relief valve domed nut
engine.lube.relief-nut.notes: The large domed hexagon nut at the left-hand rear of the engine (Haynes Sec 17 para 1).

engine.lube.relief-washer.name: Relief valve sealing washer
engine.lube.relief-washer.notes: Two fibre washers or one copper (Sec 17 para 2); fibre shown.

engine.lube.relief-spring.name: Relief valve spring
engine.lube.relief-spring.notes: Opens at 70 lbf/in2 (Haynes p22). Shown at its fitted length in the bore.

specs.label: Fitted length
specs.ref: In the bore with the nut home

engine.lube.relief-cup.name: Relief valve cup
engine.lube.relief-cup.notes: Renew it if the seat appears flawed (Sec 17 para 5).

engine.lube.dipstick.name: Dipstick
engine.lube.dipstick.notes: On the right-hand side of the engine, marked for the correct oil level (Haynes Sec 2 para 1).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: From the handle to the sump floor in this layout

engine.manifolds.exhaust.name: Exhaust manifold
engine.manifolds.exhaust.notes: Cast iron. Three ports matching the head (the centre one siamesed for Nos 2 and 3), branches sweeping down past the tappet covers to one outlet with a two-stud flange for the down pipe (photo 61.1(a)).

specs.label: Branch bore
specs.ref: Matches the head exhaust ports; not published

engine.manifolds.inlet.name: Inlet manifold
engine.manifolds.inlet.notes: Two runners from the siamesed inlet ports to the twin SU carburettor flanges, joined by a balance pipe (photo 61.1(b)).

specs.label: Runner bore
specs.ref: Equal to the SU HS4 bore (1.5 in); runner bore not published

engine.manifolds.gasket.name: Manifold gasket
engine.manifolds.gasket.notes: One gasket for all five ports (owners' photos); Haynes Sec 61 - use a new gasket.

engine.manifolds.washer-large.name: Manifold washer (large)
engine.manifolds.washer-large.notes: Haynes Sec 15 - the four centre nuts have large washers.

engine.manifolds.washer-small.name: Manifold washer (small)
engine.manifolds.washer-small.notes: Haynes Sec 15 - the two end nuts have small washers.

specs.label: Across flats
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/16 in

specs.label: Thickness
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/16 in

engine.timing.cam-wheel.name: Camshaft chainwheel
engine.timing.cam-wheel.notes: Duplex wheel with a dished web and two lightening holes (photo 51.3). The timing dimple lines up with the one on the crankshaft wheel (Fig 1.25 item 2). Its 40 teeth against the crankshaft's 20 and the 52-pitch chain set the camshaft height in this model.

specs.label: Teeth
specs.ref: Steve Strange, Tuning the B-Series Engine

specs.label: Pitch diameter
specs.ref: 3/8 in pitch on 40 teeth: p / sin(180/40)

specs.label: Bore
specs.ref: Fits the camshaft nose; not published

engine.timing.crank-wheel.name: Crankshaft chainwheel
engine.timing.crank-wheel.notes: Duplex wheel on a long hub, keyed to the crankshaft; packing washers behind it set the alignment with the camshaft wheel (Haynes Sec 51 para 7).

specs.label: Teeth
specs.ref: Steve Strange, Tuning the B-Series Engine

specs.label: Pitch diameter
specs.ref: 3/8 in pitch on 20 teeth: p / sin(180/20)

specs.label: Bore
specs.ref: Fits the crankshaft snout; not published

engine.timing.chain.name: Timing chain (duplex)
engine.timing.chain.notes: Double roller chain on the 18G (Haynes Sec 19, "double-roller chain type"). Rollers, pins and side plates are modelled link by link round the real path.

specs.label: Pitches
specs.ref: Steve Strange, Tuning the B-Series Engine; British Parts Northwest 52-link dual row chain

specs.label: Pitch
specs.ref: Steve Strange, Tuning the B-Series Engine

engine.timing.tensioner-body.name: Chain tensioner body
engine.timing.tensioner-body.notes: Bolted to the block through the front plate with two bolts and a tab washer (Sec 18 para 3). The bottom plug gives access for a 1/8 in Allen key (Sec 19 para 10).

engine.timing.tensioner-slipper.name: Tensioner slipper head and plunger
engine.timing.tensioner-slipper.notes: Rubber slipper on the plunger; it presses on the run on the right-hand side (Fig 1.25).

engine.timing.tensioner-cylinder.name: Tensioner inner cylinder
engine.timing.tensioner-cylinder.notes: Helical slot engages the peg in the plunger (Sec 52 para 2).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the flange, backplate and front plate

engine.timing.tensioner-lockwasher.name: Tensioner tab washer
engine.timing.tensioner-lockwasher.notes: Haynes Sec 18 para 3 - knock back the lockwasher tabs.

engine.timing.locating-plate.name: Camshaft locating plate
engine.timing.locating-plate.notes: Three-lobed plate held by three bolts with spring washers (Haynes Sec 23 para 10, photo 50.5).

specs.label: Across flats
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/8 in

specs.label: Thickness
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/8 in

engine.timing.cam-lockwasher.name: Camshaft nut lockwasher
engine.timing.cam-lockwasher.notes: Haynes Sec 19 para 11 - bend back the lockwasher tag on the camshaft nut.

engine.timing.packing-washer.name: Crankshaft wheel packing washer
engine.timing.packing-washer.notes: Haynes Sec 51 para 7 - add or remove packing washers behind the crankshaft wheel to line the two wheels up.

engine.timing.oil-thrower.name: Oil thrower
engine.timing.oil-thrower.notes: Dished disc in front of the crankshaft wheel; concave side facing forward on early engines (Haynes Sec 51 para 9).

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: Inside the cover seal housing; not published

engine.timing.cover.name: Timing cover
engine.timing.cover.notes: Pressed steel cover round both wheels and the tensioner, scalloped flange, oil seal housing for the pulley hub and ignition timing pointers below the crankshaft (photos 51.12, 51.15). The cover bolts are of different sizes (Sec 19 para 8).

specs.label: Thread diameter
specs.ref: Not in Haynes; Haynes notes the sizes vary

engine.timing.crank-pulley.name: Crankshaft pulley
engine.timing.crank-pulley.notes: Single groove for the fan belt; its hub runs in the timing cover seal (photo 51.15).

specs.label: Hub length
specs.ref: From the oil thrower to the snout end

engine.timing.pulley-lockwasher.name: Crankshaft pulley lockwasher
engine.timing.pulley-lockwasher.notes: Haynes Sec 19 para 5 - bend back the locking tab on the crankshaft pulley bolt.

fuel.carbs.body-front.name: Carburettor body (front)
fuel.carbs.body-front.notes: SU HS4 die-cast body: engine flange, barrel, intake flange for the air cleaner, the tower the suction chamber screws to, the jet housing below and the lug for the float chamber bolt. Float chambers sit outboard of each instrument; the front and rear bodies are handed (Fig 3.10 items 1 and 2).

specs.label: Jet size
specs.note: Haynes prints 2.2 mm for 0.090 in; the inch figure governs

specs.label: Needle
specs.note: 18G and 18GA: No 5 standard, No 6 rich, No 21 weak

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the body and out to the coupling

fuel.carbs.throttle-lever.name: Throttle lever
fuel.carbs.throttle-lever.notes: Carries the throttle (idle speed) adjusting screw (Fig 3.12 item 1).

fuel.carbs.suction-chamber.name: Suction chamber
fuel.carbs.suction-chamber.notes: Supplied with its piston as one assembly (item 6); held by three screws (item 7).

fuel.carbs.piston.name: Suction piston and needle
fuel.carbs.piston.notes: The tapered needle (item 19) is held in the piston by its screw (Fig 3.11 item 2); No 5 needle on the 18G (Haynes p66).

fuel.carbs.damper.name: Cap and damper
fuel.carbs.damper.notes: Top up the hollow piston rod with engine oil to 1/2 in above the rod (Haynes Sec 17 para 7, photo 17.7).

specs.label: Oil level
specs.note: Above the top of the hollow rod

fuel.carbs.jet-front.name: Jet assembly (front)
fuel.carbs.jet-front.notes: Jet with its head and the feed tube from the float chamber (Fig 3.11 items 6 and 7).

fuel.carbs.float-chamber-front.name: Float chamber (front)
fuel.carbs.float-chamber-front.notes: Held to the body by a bolt through rubber grommets (items 22-26).

fuel.carbs.float-lid-front.name: Float chamber lid (front)
fuel.carbs.float-lid-front.notes: Fuel inlet union and overflow pipe (Haynes Sec 18 para 1); needle and seat inside (item 32).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the chamber lug into the body

fuel.carbs.heat-shield.name: Heat shield
fuel.carbs.heat-shield.notes: One shield between the manifold flanges and both instruments (Haynes Sec 18 para 5, photo 18.5).

fuel.carbs.distance-piece.name: Distance piece
fuel.carbs.distance-piece.notes: Composition insulating blocks between the heat shield and each carburettor (Haynes Sec 18 para 5).

fuel.carbs.flange-gasket.name: Carburettor flange gasket
fuel.carbs.flange-gasket.notes: Two gaskets either side of each distance piece, plus one at each manifold flange (Sec 18 para 5).

specs.label: Across flats
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/16 in

specs.label: Thickness
specs.ref: ANSI/ASME B18.2.2 finished hex nut, 5/16 in

fuel.carbs.coupling-shaft.name: Throttle interconnecting shaft
fuel.carbs.coupling-shaft.notes: Folded clamps with pinch bolts at each end; loosen them to adjust the instruments separately (Haynes Sec 21 para 2, photo 17.1(b)).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: From the lever to the heat shield

fuel.carbs.cleaner-case-front.name: Air cleaner case (front)
fuel.carbs.cleaner-case-front.notes: The rocker cover breather pipe connects to the front air cleaner (Haynes Sec 3 para 1).

fuel.carbs.cleaner-bolt.name: Air cleaner bolt
fuel.carbs.cleaner-bolt.notes: Two bolts secure each air cleaner to its carburettor flange (Haynes Sec 3 para 1).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the case and baseplate into the intake flange

fuel.pipes.float-hose-front.name: Fuel hose, front float chamber
fuel.pipes.float-hose-front.notes: From the inlet union on the front float chamber lid down under the instruments to the tee ("disconnect the fuel pipe hose(s) from the float chamber(s)", Sec 18 para 1). Run kept below the jets and throttle return springs (D).

specs.label: Bore
specs.ref: 5/16 in fuel hose, standard for SU HS4 float chamber unions

fuel.pipes.tee.name: Fuel tee
fuel.pipes.tee.notes: Joins the two float chamber hoses to the feed from the pump (D).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Two hose spigots and the body

fuel.pipes.feed-hose.name: Fuel feed hose (engine end)
fuel.pipes.feed-hose.notes: From the tee toward the bulkhead; the rigid pipe to the pump at the rear of the car joins at the union and is added with the body.

fuel.pipes.breather-hose.name: Rocker cover breather pipe
fuel.pipes.breather-hose.notes: From the spigot at the front of the rocker cover to the spigot on the front air cleaner; disconnected first when the air cleaners come off (Ch 3 Sec 3 para 1) and renewed if perished. Routed over the front float chamber (D).

ignition.distributor.housing.name: Distributor housing
ignition.distributor.housing.notes: Cast housing pushed into the leaning boss on the right-hand side of the block and held by a single bolt and washer (Ch 1 Sec 16 para 2, Sec 63 para 5). The distributor clamping plate bolts to its flange. Haynes gives no drawing of the housing itself: the spigot, flange and bolt tab are proportioned to the block boss and the 25D4 shank (D). The skew gear path inside the block is approximated: the drive shaft is modelled coaxial with the housing.

specs.label: Bore
specs.ref: Running clearance over the 25D4 shank, 26.8 mm

ignition.distributor.drive-shaft.name: Distributor driveshaft
ignition.distributor.drive-shaft.notes: Skew-geared shaft driven from the camshaft; the offset slot at its top takes the distributor driving dog, set just below horizontal with the large segment uppermost at TDC on No 1 (Ch 1 Sec 63 paras 2-4, Fig 1.26). A 5/16 in UNF bolt - a tappet cover bolt - screws into its head to lift it out (Sec 16 para 3).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: From the housing face down to the camshaft gear line in the block section

specs.label: Withdrawal thread
specs.note: 5/16 in UNF bolt into the drive head (Sec 16 para 3)

ignition.distributor.housing-bolt.name: Housing retaining bolt
ignition.distributor.housing-bolt.notes: The single retaining bolt for the housing (Sec 16 para 2; Sec 63 para 5 'secure with the bolt and washer').

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the housing tab into the block lug

ignition.distributor.clamp-plate.name: Clamping plate
ignition.distributor.clamp-plate.notes: Split ring round the distributor shank with its pinch bolt, and a tongue with two bolt holes onto the housing flange. Removing the plate bolts and leaving the pinch bolt alone keeps the timing (Sec 6 para 7). Shape from Fig 4.3.

ignition.distributor.pinch-bolt.name: Clamping plate pinch bolt and nut

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Across the split lug in Fig 4.3

ignition.distributor.clamp-bolt.name: Clamping plate bolt
ignition.distributor.clamp-bolt.notes: Sec 6 para 7, "remove the distributor body clamp plate bolts".

ignition.distributor.body.name: Distributor body (Lucas 25D4)
ignition.distributor.body.notes: Lucas 25D4, serial 40897 for 18G high compression. Die-cast body: plain shank in the housing, a waist carrying the vacuum spindle bracket, and a conical bowl with the two clip pivots, the low tension terminal block (item 7) and a lug at the rim (Fig 4.3). Rotor turns anticlockwise seen from above (p95). Shape from Fig 4.3 and Fig 4.2; sizes proportioned from the 66 mm cap.

specs.label: Shank diameter
specs.ref: Proportion from Fig 4.3 against the cap

ignition.distributor.vacuum-unit.name: Vacuum unit
ignition.distributor.vacuum-unit.notes: Diaphragm housing with the pipe union, the threaded spindle through the body bracket and the knurled micrometer adjusting nut held by a small circlip (Sec 6 para 13). Shape from Fig 4.3.

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Proportion from Fig 4.3: a little over half the bowl

ignition.distributor.cap-clip.name: Cap retaining clip
ignition.distributor.cap-clip.notes: Pull away the two clips to lift off the cap (Sec 3 para 1).

ignition.distributor.cap.name: Distributor cap
ignition.distributor.cap.notes: Moulded side-entry cap: the four plug leads enter bosses on the upper wall and are held by pointed screws on the shoulder; the coil lead enters the centre tower. Leads fitted in the order 1-3-4-2 anticlockwise (Sec 2, p95). Four metal segments inside; renew if cracked or the segments are badly burnt (Sec 3 para 1).

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Proportion from Fig 4.3 and the 25D4 body

ignition.distributor.baseplate.name: Contact breaker baseplate and contacts
ignition.distributor.baseplate.notes: Baseplate held by two screws with the earth lead (item 10); the moving plate carries the contact set on its pivot post (Sec 3, Sec 6 para 9).

ignition.distributor.capacitor.name: Capacitor
ignition.distributor.capacitor.notes: Capacity 0.18 to 0.24 microfarad (p95). Suppresses arcing at the contacts (Sec 5).

ignition.distributor.shaft.name: Shaft, action plate, weights, cam and driving dog
ignition.distributor.shaft.notes: Centrifugal advance weights on the action plate turn the four-lobe cam ahead of the shaft as speed rises (Sec 1). The offset driving dog is pinned to the lower end (item 20) and engages the slot in the driveshaft.

specs.label: Dynamic timing
specs.note: Stroboscopic timing at 600 rpm, BTDC, vacuum pipe off

ignition.distributor.ht-lead-1.name: HT lead, No 1 cylinder
ignition.distributor.ht-lead-1.notes: No 1 is the cylinder nearest the radiator (p94).

ignition.distributor.plug-cap.name: Plug cap
ignition.distributor.plug-cap.notes: Moulded cap pushed over the plug terminal (Sec 2 para 4 for the leads).
